title: Maximal hypersurfaces with prescribed light-like cones in Lorentz-Minkowski space
summary: The purpose in this paper is to study the maximal hypersurfaces with multiple light-cones in Lorentz-Minkowski space by considering the weak solutions to the mean curvature equation with multiple Dirac masses. Such solutions are constructed via an approximation procedure, using regular solutions with smooth sources that converge weakly to the Dirac measures.
